tasks.title: product_name extracted in all commerce parsers
tasks.description: Open each url_data_parser/commerce_crawl/*.py and confirm product_name field is returned.

tasks.title: brand extracted in all commerce parsers
tasks.description: Add brand extraction if missing. Sources: ld+json, og:brand meta, breadcrumbs, or product title prefix.

tasks.title: category and subcategory extracted in all commerce parsers
tasks.description: Extract from breadcrumb trail or URL path. e.g. /women/co-ords/linen-co-ords → category=Co-ords, subcategory=Linen Co-ords.

tasks.title: list_price (MRP) extracted in all commerce parsers
tasks.description: The original struck-through price. Strip ₹, commas. Store as float.

tasks.title: selling_price extracted in all commerce parsers
tasks.description: Current selling price. Store as float in INR.

tasks.title: discount_pct computed and stored
tasks.description: discount_pct = round((list_price - selling_price) / list_price * 100, 1). Handle missing list_price gracefully.

tasks.title: color extracted in all commerce parsers
tasks.description: From product title, attributes section, or color swatches. Store primary color string.

tasks.title: fabric extracted in all commerce parsers
tasks.description: From product description or specifications table. Keywords: linen, cotton, viscose, polyester, chiffon, etc.

tasks.title: size_available extracted in all commerce parsers
tasks.description: List of available sizes. Store as array: ['XS','S','M','L','XL']. Extract from size picker on page.

tasks.title: platform, crawl_date, url, image_url stored
tasks.description: platform = site name string. crawl_date = ISO date. image_url from og:image or first product image.

tasks.title: rating and review_count extracted where available
tasks.description: From ld+json AggregateRating or page HTML. Store null if unavailable — do not default to 0.

tasks.title: in_stock boolean extracted
tasks.description: Check availability section or add-to-cart button state. Store as true/false.

tasks.title: headline extracted in all media parsers
tasks.description: From h1 tag, og:title, or article:title. Clean whitespace.

tasks.title: publication_date extracted in all media parsers
tasks.description: From article:published_time meta, ld+json datePublished, or visible date on page. Store as ISO datetime.

tasks.title: body_text (full article text) extracted
tasks.description: All paragraph text joined. This is the most important field — used for keyword extraction and trend detection.

tasks.title: site, url, author, category_tags stored
tasks.description: site = outlet name. author from byline. category_tags from article tags/topics section.

tasks.title: Build trend_lag.py — keyword article count per week from ES
tasks.description: Query ES articles index for each keyword per ISO week. Find peak week. Output weeks-of-lag per trend.

tasks.title: Define trend keyword vocabulary list
tasks.description: e.g. ['linen co-ord','Y2K','gender neutral','resort set','kantha','smocked','crochet top','oversized linen','colour block','butter yellow']

tasks.title: Cross-reference keyword counts with product SKU counts
tasks.description: Query ES products index for each keyword. Compute lag = peak_article_week - today. Output JSON.

tasks.title: Build heatmap.py — article count per trend per platform
tasks.description: For each trend keyword × platform combination: count articles (media index) and count SKUs (products index). Compute ratio.

tasks.title: Build price_bands.py using ES range aggregation
tasks.description: Bucket all products by selling_price per category per platform. Bands: <399, 400-699, 700-999, 1000-1499, 1500-2499, 2500-4999, 5000+.

tasks.title: Build color_extractor.py — scan product titles + article body
tasks.description: Define color vocabulary. Scan all product_name and body_text fields. Count per color. Compare this month vs last month.

tasks.title: Build color vocabulary list with hex codes
tasks.description: Map color names to hex: dusty rose #C9A0A0, sage green #8FAF8F, butter yellow #F5D98B, etc. Minimum 20 colors.

tasks.title: Build attribute_extractor.py — fabric, silhouette, sleeve, detail keywords
tasks.description: Scan product_name and body_text for attribute vocab lists. Count per term. Compute MoM delta vs last crawl.

tasks.title: Build all 4 attribute vocabulary lists
tasks.description: Fabric vocab, silhouette vocab, sleeve/length vocab, detailing/embellishment vocab. Each 10-15 terms.

tasks.title: Build discount_calculator.py using ES avg aggregation
tasks.description: For each platform + category: avg of discount_pct field. Also bucket into <20%, 20-35%, 35-50%, >50% distribution.

tasks.title: Build brand_counter.py using ES terms aggregation
tasks.description: Group products by brand field per category. Count SKUs. Compare to previous month crawl to compute growth %.

tasks.title: Build size_gap.py — count SKUs per size per category
tasks.description: ES terms agg on size_available field per category. Pair supply counts with manually input demand index from Google Trends.

tasks.title: Build keyword_tracker.py — ngram extraction from article headlines
tasks.description: Tokenize all article headlines into 2–4 word ngrams. Count this month vs last month. Filter to fashion-relevant phrases.

tasks.title: Build reports/generate_report.py master script
tasks.description: Runs all 8 analytics scripts in sequence. Collects all outputs. Writes reports/data.js with const REPORT = {...}.

tasks.title: Refactor index.html to load data.js externally
tasks.description: Remove inline REPORT object. Add <script src='data.js'></script>. Test that charts render from external file.

tasks.title: Choose publishing method (GitHub Pages / S3 / Netlify)
tasks.description: GitHub Pages: free, push reports/ folder. Netlify: drag-and-drop deploy. S3: aws s3 sync reports/ s3://bucket --acl public-read.

tasks.title: Schedule generate_report.py to run on 1st of month
tasks.description: Add cron job: 0 9 1 * * cd /path/to/SARA && python reports/generate_report.py

tasks.title: Set up Google Keyword Planner account
tasks.description: Free via Google Ads account. Export monthly search volumes for tracked keywords as CSV.

tasks.title: Install pytrends for Google Trends automation
tasks.description: pip install pytrends. Build a script that pulls relative interest for all tracked trend keywords monthly.

tasks.title: Export first Google Trends CSV for all tracked keywords
tasks.description: Go to trends.google.com, add all 10+ trend keywords, set region=India, export CSV for last 12 months.

tasks.title: Download Myntra media kit / audience report
tasks.description: Myntra publishes audience demographics. Use for age split data in the report. Contact Myntra Ads or find on their advertiser portal.

tasks.title: Collect annual platform sale calendar dates
tasks.description: EORS (June/Dec), Big Billion Day (Oct), Great Indian Festival (Oct), Nykaa sale dates. Add to campaign calendar data.

tasks.title: Download IAMAI / Redseer Indian e-commerce report
tasks.description: For market size, GMV, and size segment data (e.g. '71M plus-size shoppers'). Free PDFs available online.

tasks.title: Set up monthly crawl schedule for all 20 sites
tasks.description: Configure all sites to run on days 1-7 of each month via the SARA scheduler. Verify schedule YAML files.

tasks.title: Run generate_report.py for the first real report
tasks.description: After first full crawl completes. Compare real numbers to placeholder. Fix any zero or broken fields.

tasks.title: Sanity check all report numbers
tasks.description: Verify: total URLs > 50K, SKU counts per platform look realistic, discounts are %, prices are INR not paise.

tasks.title: Publish report and share with stakeholders
tasks.description: Deploy updated data.js + index.html. Send report URL. Document any data quality issues found this cycle.
